IDSSE.name: Bassek, Rein, Weber and Memmert: An integrated dataset of spatiotemporal and event data in elite soccer
IDSSE.attribution: Bassek M, Rein R, Weber H, Memmert D. Data owner: Deutsche Fussball Liga; collection: Sportec Solutions.
IDSSE.version: Figshare v1, 2025; analysis mirror PySport/idsse-data revision a715a38dfbaf5f58e431727c2b78d174101a703c
IDSSE.changes: Prepared fixed histories, masks, native coordinates, event clocks, recorded-Shot labels, model-generated features and summaries; preserve source attribution and describe further changes.

SkillCorner.name: SkillCorner Open Data
SkillCorner.attribution: SkillCorner, in collaboration with PySport. Copyright (c) 2020 SkillCorner.
SkillCorner.changes: Selected fixed cohorts; prepared prefix states, masks, source identities, normalization, commands and statistical diagnostics. No grant for unlisted video or commercial products.

SoccerTrack.attribution: SoccerTrack dataset creators; see the provider dataset card and pinned LICENSE-DATA notice.

SoccerTrack.license: CC-BY-4.0 within the pinned released-data scope
SoccerTrack.changes: Provider-coordinate and clock checks and player-only statistical analyses. This release does not add a raw SoccerTrack mirror or authenticate old legacy tracker files.

Metrica.name: Metrica Sports Sample Data
Metrica.license: Provider terms retained; no author grant over provider materials
Metrica.changes: Nonreconstructive analytical summaries only; obtain tracking and event records from the provider.
